$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/sales.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context: the expiry sweep, the deposit request and order made after an acceptance) writes quotes, deposit requests and orders through apps/factory-api's modules/sales, always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and parties their grants reach. A portal or one-off link session (factory_partner_runtime) reads only its OWN party's rows (every table here carries the party's partyId), never a cost, margin or internal column nor which office user wrote a row (the partner wall of src/ownership.ts: every column marked `@internal` or with a cost, margin or wages grain is hidden); prices stay readable, they are the party's own document. The accept link (QUOTE_ACCEPT) answers in the partner scope, in one command: it updates its party's SENT version and quote to ACCEPTED or DECLINED and adds the QuoteAcceptance row; the …_sales_guards triggers refuse any other partner change. The floor reads nothing here: a work order carries the style, colour, sizes and dates it needs. Nobody deletes a header: a quote is cancelled, a version superseded, an order or deposit request cancelled; the office deletes only the lines and size rows of a DRAFT version or of an order that is still CONFIRMED, IN_PRODUCTION or READY (the triggers hold the states for every login). QuoteAcceptance and SalesOrderAmendment are append-only (`@append-only`; the triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Quote.about: The office creates quotes, moves their status with their current version, cancels them and keeps the lost reason. A portal or link session reads its own party's quotes, and its accept or decline moves a SENT quote to ACCEPTED or DECLINED (nothing else: the trigger).

QuoteVersion.about: The office drafts versions, asks for approval, sends them (the send freezes them), supersedes, expires and cancels them. A portal or link session reads its own party's versions without cost, margin or who sent them, and its accept or decline moves a SENT version to ACCEPTED or DECLINED with its decision note (nothing else: the trigger).

QuoteLine.about: The office edits the lines of a DRAFT version (and deletes them). A portal or link session reads its own party's lines with their prices, never their cost, margin, cost sheet or the internal adjustment reason.

QuoteLineSize.about: The office types the size quantities of a DRAFT version's lines (and deletes them). A portal or link session reads its own party's.

QuoteApproval.about: The office asks for an approval of a version and an approver decides it; a version changed first withdraws it. Office only: it holds the margin and its floor.

QuoteAcceptance.about: The accept link adds one row in its party's scope (WITH CHECK); the office records an acceptance from a signed copy or a written reply, and reads them. A portal or link session reads its own party's acceptances. Nobody changes or removes a row.

DepositRequest.about: The office (or the system context, after an acceptance) asks for a deposit, names its order, marks it PAID when the payments cover it, waives or cancels it. A portal or link session reads its own party's deposit requests, without the internal note.

SalesOrder.about: The office (or the system context) makes an order from an accepted version, amends, moves, closes and cancels it. A portal or link session reads its own party's orders without the cost or the internal note.

SalesOrderLine.about: The office writes an order's lines (an amendment deletes one) while the order is CONFIRMED, IN_PRODUCTION or READY. A portal or link session reads its own party's order lines with their prices, never their cost.

SalesOrderLineSize.about: The office writes the size quantities of an order's lines while the order is CONFIRMED, IN_PRODUCTION or READY. A portal or link session reads its own party's.

SalesOrderAmendment.about: The office (modules/sales/orders, B-W2a-30) adds one row for each amendment of a confirmed order, in the command that changes its lines: the order before and after, the money change, the reason. Nobody changes or removes one. A portal or link session reads none yet (the re-acceptance link of a changed order is W2b, SAL-190: then the partner role reads its own party's amendments, without who made them).

SalesOrderMilestone.about: The office makes an order's payment schedule from its payment terms, makes it again with an amendment while a step is OPEN, marks a step PAID, waives or cancels it. A portal or link session reads none yet (the customer's order page with its schedule is W2b).

SalesSettings.about: The office keeps the sales settings of each company and the tenant-wide ones: the margin floor, the discount limit, the default validity and deposit of a quote; the quotes read them. Rows are changed, never deleted (the …_sales_settings_guards triggers). The floor and the portal read none of it.
